card.thesis: Round 45 cell on the taxable trading book: base `bee` (persona: Creator C (creator-c)), entry 'close > sma(100) and ema(12) crosses_above ema(50)', exit 'ema(12) crosses_below ema(50)', stop 0.08, take-profit 0.16, hold cap 30, 5 slots at 0.15 each. This base is a VAULT DRAFT (`data/vault/influencers/creator-c/strategy/1.json`), machine-mapped from the persona's described methodology onto this programme's fixed rule vocabulary -- fidelity 0.38. The draft's rationale: "A 12/50 EMA crossover inside a 100-day regime filter directly represents this approach." Every note behind it has `published = null` (`PERSONA-HYPOTHESES.md` section 7), so hindsight against this round's eight windows is unbounded; the draft is inspired by, not a faithful reproduction of, what the persona actually trades. Arm `trim115`, borrowed from Creator B (wsaj)'s trim-after-exceptional-gains discipline: exit becomes 'ema(12) crosses_below ema(50) or close > sma(200) * 1.15' -- the base exit plus 'or close > sma(200) * 1.15', nothing else changed. Predicted to lower exposure and lose to the base in bull-2024 and recent (r44's trim arm: +0.4 to +2.4pp, null). Pre-registered 2026-09-09, before any measurement (see strategy-program/ROUND-45-PLAN.md and strategy-program/MIX-AND-MATCH-PLAN.md section 3). Nothing here is promotable -- the `trading` purpose is exempt from PROTOCOL.md section 6 promotion (r21 amendment); this is a measurement study, report only. Not investment advice.

Decision rule: an enhancement earns something only if its marginal -- the mean over its bases of (arm median adjusted excess minus base median) -- exceeds the floor AND its arm cells survive BH q<0.10 over m=14 (each arm cell contrasted with its own base; base cells carry p=None but count in m). Pre-registered predictions: (1) null for all four enhancements. (2) `trend100` cuts trades vs base on both bases it applies to (kim, wsaj). (3) `rr5` cells are nearly identical to their base -- fewer than 10% of exits are expected to be the take-profit target, counted from the run files' trade logs. Sign flips by regime are expected; only the eight-window median is safe to read.
